actual: Research Assistant token ledger records provider usage, but chat and audit pages show llm_usage_summary_unavailable / cost unavailable for DeepSeek v4 pro. Root evidence: assistant_llm_usage_events has usage_status=recorded but cost_status=unavailable, cost_reason_code includes litellm_cost_per_token_failed / model isn't mapped yet for deepseek/deepseek-v4-pro. Short-term target: correctly compute and show cost for current DeepSeek usage without silent fallback. Mid-term target: preserve pricing snapshots while allowing future LiteLLM price-map updates to be picked up automatically for new events. No DDL, no production DB connection, no service restart in this fix.
